facts.fact: Minister Samuel Nartey George said the ministry is advancing Ghana's AI strategy with the KNUST Responsible AI Lab and local industry partners, to be launched by the end of the first quarter of 2026.

GHA.note: No AI model, dataset or computing stated.
Training named is for the public, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The minister said 15 new and amended bills, including on data protection, were at various stages and would soon go to Cabinet after stakeholder consultations.

Government set a target to train 400,000 Ghanaians in 2026 under the One Million Coders Programme, after a 2025 pilot that trained 859, with 20,000 laptops procured and training planned in 100 constituencies by end of the first quarter of 2026.
